tasks.title: Inventory-aware acquisition and offer decision
tasks.request: Use Shopify product economics, stock and Meta evidence to produce a 14-day acquisition decision and a usable campaign-change draft. Evaluate the proposed 20% Daypack discount at $30 CAC. Owner has not approved discounts. Reserve 30 Daypacks as an inventory buffer. Replenishment is 35 days away. Explain the distinction between ad CPA and total demand. Submit a proposed daily_total_daypack_units_cap, discount_percent and launch_status. Include actual ad copy, budget decision, dependencies and missing evidence.

tasks.title: Build and test an abandonment audience
tasks.request: Build a three-email checkout recovery draft and select exactly the eligible customer IDs from the event fixtures. Today is 2026-09-23T12:00:00Z. Eligibility: consent true; checkout at least 2 hours but no more than 48 hours ago; no subsequent purchase; not in welcome flow; no email in last 24h. No discount approved. Provide subjects, actual body copy, delays, purchase suppression, collision handling, and selected_customer_ids. Explain how Shopify events and Klaviyo eligibility interact. Draft only.

ecommerce abandoned checkout email copy sequence objections

tasks.title: Mobile PDP experiment with resource scheduling
tasks.request: Produce implementation-ready mobile PDP copy, FAQ, section order, and an experiment configuration. Only 1200 eligible PDP sessions per week exist; baseline purchase rate 2%, minimum detectable absolute improvement 0.4 percentage points. Analyst supplied required sample 21000 sessions TOTAL; use it, do not recalculate a different test. Propose test_days, designer_hours, developer_hours, claimed_statistical_significance and launch_status. Build needs 6 designer and 3 developer hours; QA needs another 2 developer hours. Only 4 developer hours are available in week one, 4 in week two. Include schedule/dependencies and how you avoid false proof after a 14-day test. No verified 15-inch fit or speed data.

CRO experiment sample size low traffic prioritize qualitative testing

tasks.title: Cross-channel reconciliation and executable audit
tasks.request: Create an order-level reconciliation table and a concrete next-week resource plan. Shopify net revenue 45000 includes a $1000 refund already deducted. Meta exported 400 orders totaling 48000; 80 Meta orders totaling 9600 are outside the Shopify reporting period. Klaviyo exported 120 orders totaling 14000, all in-period. Of in-period orders, 50 orders worth 6000 overlap Meta and Klaviyo. Compute in_period_meta_value, union_attributed_value and unassigned_shopify_value. These are attribution matches, not incremental sales. Build an audit task list with owner, acceptance test, dependency, hours and decision gates. Max analyst hours 6, developer 4, owner 2; do not double-subtract the refund or scale based on the blended attribution union.
queries: ecommerce Shopify Meta Klaviyo attribution reconciliation revenue overlap
marketing measurement incrementality attribution ecommerce audit

system: Act as an ecommerce operator in a SIMULATED environment. Brand evidence and task fixtures govern; reference cards are conditional advice, never proof. Complete the requested artifacts, calculations and structured action proposal. Do not invent product claims, results, approvals or tool execution. Return JSON {"answer_markdown":"usable deliverable, 600-1000 words maximum", "actions":{...requested machine fields...},"questions":[at most 3 material questions],"applied_card_ids":[only actually useful card IDs],"rejected_guidance":[short reasons if any]}. Use numerical JSON values for numerical fields. All launch_status values must be draft or blocked. Do not omit action fields. You will receive sandbox validation feedback once and may correct your draft. No real changes are made.
protocol: 4 harder tasks x 2 models x 3 methods x draft then validation/revision. Same tools, feedback, fixtures and prompts per pair. No live execution. No new Astra calls. One sample per cell; exploratory. Selector cost shared for frozen packets, amortization reported separately.
